note: Cobalt mining in DRC (artisanal mining, child labor risk), lithium extraction in Chile/Argentina (water stress, indigenous rights). EU Battery Regulation due-diligence requirements from Feb 2025.

For ICE vehicles, use-phase is ~65% of lifecycle emissions (BMW 2024). Transition to BEV shifts the hotspot from use-phase to battery production. Requires dual-track SBT pathway (ICE reduction + BEV ramp).
EU ban on new ICE sales from 2035, UK from 2030 (delayed to 2035), California from 2035. Stranded-asset risk for ICE powertrain tooling and supplier contracts.
Second-life applications for degraded EV batteries (stationary storage). EU Battery Regulation mandates recycled content targets: 16% Co, 6% Li, 6% Ni by 2031.
Lithium, cobalt, nickel, rare earths subject to geopolitical concentration (China refining dominance). EU Critical Raw Materials Act and US IRA domestic-sourcing requirements.

topic: EU fleet CO2 target compliance penalties
note: €95 per g CO2/km exceeded × vehicles sold. VW paid €100M+ in 2021. 2025 target: 93.6 g/km; 2030: 49.5 g/km; 2035: 0 g/km.
BMW, VW, Mercedes require Tier-1 suppliers to share product-level carbon footprints via the Catena-X ecosystem. Non-participation risks contract loss.
Revised EU ELV Directive proposal: mandatory recycled content targets in new vehicles, extended producer responsibility, digital vehicle passport.
Every 100kg mass reduction saves ~0.3-0.5 L/100km (ICE) or ~0.4 kWh/100km (BEV). Carbon fiber, high-strength steel, aluminum body panels — direct PCF and use-phase lever.
Level 4+ autonomy adds 500-2000W continuous compute load. For BEVs, this can reduce range 5-15% and increase use-phase carbon. Material for fleet deployment planning.
